reasons.persona_fit: Accurately targets a small-business owner-operator and respects the no-CTA rule; slight minor slip using first-person singular ('I'd') rather than Bareni's standard public 'we'.
reasons.clarity: The core distinction between document-grounded tasks and open-ended judgment is stated clearly, logically organised, and plainly qualified on a first read.
reasons.actionability: Provides a practical diagnostic question and a feasible next step (auditing one recurring workflow against the internal-document threshold) without overreaching.
reasons.factual_grounding: Capabilities and explicit non-production limitations of the self-built knowledge assistant demo strictly match C03 without claiming customer validation or billing.
